title: Human civilization as a cargo cult from an ancient contact event

tellings.quote: concept. So our concept in starting this project was that our entire society is a cargo cult because everything we're trying to do

plain: A cargo cult is a group that copies the outward signs of visitors' technology, hoping the visitors and their gifts will return. Peter Levenda, a researcher and writer, says that when he and the musician Tom DeLonge began their book project Sekret Machines: Gods, their starting idea was that our whole society is such a cargo cult, built around a contact event at the dawn of civilization. If true, much of human striving would be an effort to recover what those first visitors showed us.
